target_customer: Real estate developers, real estate investors and general contractors who need preconstruction cost estimates
problem: Construction cost estimates for real estate projects are slow and manual. PLAN0 reads architectural drawings with vision models and returns a priced estimate with analytics in minutes.

founders.name: Arash Barati
founders.background_notes: YC page says about 12 years in real estate private equity, development and lending covering over $7B of projects, and a stint as adjunct professor. No employers named.

founders.name: Dimitris Pagonakis
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as a former portfolio manager.

competitors.name: Bild AI
competitors.what: YC backed AI that reads blueprints and extracts material lists and cost estimates
competitors.funding_then: one funding news item cites a $3.1M raise (headline only, not opened)

competitors.name: Togal.AI
competitors.what: AI takeoff that detects and measures elements from plans
competitors.traction_then: vendor claims up to 98% accuracy, paid plans from $299 per user per month

competitors.name: Kreo
competitors.traction_then: listed at $35 per user per month in a 2026 roundup

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading architectural drawings with vision models and pricing against market cost data is standard applied ML with hard parts in plan parsing accuracy and building a trusted cost database.

defensibility.rationale: The claimed moat is aggregated historical and real-time project cost data from industry partnerships. Several AI takeoff and estimating products already exist, and the site shows only a simulated demo project.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to know as of the batch. Nothing found on incumbents copying or buying it.

market_need_then: Takeoff and estimating tools are a crowded 2026 category, which signals demand. The company claims $20B to $30B of projects running through the platform (two figures on YC pages), self reported and unverified.

branding.domain_note: Uses plan0.ai, a .ai domain; no acquisition story found.

identity.logo: not described in any source found
identity.visual_style: Tagline on site: architectural drawings in, priced building out
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and finance-oriented, pitched as the Bloomberg of construction

brand_strength.rationale: Only YC pages and aggregators mention it. No press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: PLAN0 is a Spring 2026 company with four people and no exit, shutdown or layoff reports found. Its edge is founders from real estate private equity and quant finance, which gives domain access, while the product category of AI plan reading is crowded. Outcome is still open and no success or failure factor is supported yet.
notes: Aggregators (VCBacked, Caplight, Neuronfeed) show about $500K pre-seed with YC as investor; one aggregator says $4M and founded 2021. Both are unverified and not recorded as rounds. YC page names Arash Barati and Dimitris Pagonakis as founders; a launch post mentions Shervin Barati (ex-Apple) as a partner but he is not listed as a founder so is omitted. Traction claim is $30B on the YC page and $20B in the launch post. Searches for outcome found nothing about PLAN0. Update: the 500K pre-seed is now recorded from VCBacked (2026-05); Neuronfeed dates a 500K round 2026-01 and labels it seed, so date and stage conflict. It rests on databases only. YC page rechecked: only Arash Barati and Dimitris Pagonakis are listed as founders, so no founder added.
